verdict.rationale: Databricks docs confirm account-level budgets that track spending by team/project/workspace and alerting on inefficient or long-running queries, which covers cost-monitoring, but the evidence never shows an automatic auto-suspend or hard-stop mechanism that kills a runaway query or idle cluster to prevent overnight spend — budgets only track/notify, they don't state they terminate compute. missing for 10: explicit auto-suspend/cluster auto-termination policy enforcement, resource-monitor hard caps that kill jobs, and any hands-on confirmation that budgets actually halt spending rather than just alert.
